_comment: Raw kB. A route's number covers the chunk plus everything it statically imports. Lower a number when you shrink a route; never raise one. Enforced by scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs in the unit-tests job. Tightened 2026-09-03 twice: first after splitting v4PanelC.ts into v4Meta.ts (light) + v4PanelC.ts (heavy), then after the heavy map became one lazy chunk per program under v4/data/v4PanelC/ (6-32 kB each) with V4_ONLY_PROGRAMS and V4_PANEL_A_BASIS in v4Basis.ts. No route now carries the eager map; the largest chunk is the 662 kB React/router vendor chunk. Route numbers are achieved-plus-~10%; achieved was index 662, LandingPage 984, V4ReportsPage 992, AssessorPage 956, V4InsightsPage 994, V4ReportPage 1333 (all kB).
